voltage.name: Voltage
voltage.description: Voltage is the electric potential difference between two points and is measured in volts.

current.name: Current
current.description: Current is the rate of flow of electric charge and is measured in amperes.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: Resistance is the opposition to electric current and is measured in ohms.

series_circuit.name: Series Circuit
series_circuit.description: In a series circuit, components share the same current and their voltage drops add to the source voltage.

parallel_circuit.name: Parallel Circuit
parallel_circuit.description: In a parallel circuit, branches share the same voltage while the branch currents add to the total current.
